title: Immunity and Vaccines
summary: How white blood cells and antibodies fight germs, why the second response is faster, and how vaccines train the body.

ib.note: Antigens, antibodies and lymphocytes are detailed in MYP 5 / DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 3: Health: The Ultimate Treasure

objectives: I can describe how the immune system fights pathogens.
I can explain primary and secondary immune responses using a graph.
I can explain how vaccines work and evaluate their benefits.
misconceptions: Antibiotics and vaccines do the same job.
Once vaccinated, you can never get any infection.
